In (a) and (b), morphological right ventricle (RV) is identified by presence of moderator band (MB) and tricuspid valve (TV), with septal leaflet inserting in septum more apically compared with insertion of mitral valve (MV) (normal offset). Pulmonary veins (PV) are also seen to enter LA.
